role: Second preregistered confirmatory-dataset evaluation of the locked ranked-MNN promotion policy against preregistered baselines, run under the identical Phase 5C protocol
dataset_status: Never downloaded, inspected, or used in any prior FedVocabHAR phase (Phases 0-5).
sensor: iPhone 6s accelerometer and gyroscope via CoreMotion DeviceMotion; userAcceleration XYZ (device-frame linear acceleration with gravity removed) plus magnitude, from the A_DeviceMotion_data CSV files (not the raw accelerometer-only or gyroscope-only folders).
documented_unit_convention: MotionSense userAcceleration is reported in units of g (Apple CoreMotion convention), consistent with UCI-HAR's raw total_acc channel before its D2 correction. To keep the frozen encoder's input scale consistent with its RealWorld training distribution (m/s^2), an input_scale of 9.80665 is applied when building the cache, exactly as for UCI-HAR. This is declared in advance (not a discovered deviation) because the unit convention is documented in the dataset's own publication and referenced code, not learned by inspecting the downloaded files.

window.note: Same window geometry as every prior phase. MotionSense trials are variable-length per-activity CSV recordings; they are segmented into 50%-overlap windows (128 samples, stride 64) per (subject, trial) file, then pooled by activity.

subject_id_assumption: 24 participants, numbered 1-24 (sub_1.csv .. sub_24.csv per trial folder), per the dataset's published documentation. If Phase 6-A discovers a different subject count, ID range, or missing subject-activity cells, this is logged as a deviation before any further step, exactly as D1 was logged for UCI-HAR; it does not permit re-drawing folds after inspection.
fold_rule: test(f) = {f, f+6, f+12, f+18} for f=1..6 (stride-6 rotation over subjects 1-24); remaining 20 subjects, ascending, rotated left by 4*(f-1); train = first 12, selection = next 4, integration = last 4.

frozen_encoder_recipe.source: artifacts/phase3b/phase3b_decision.json (config), reused unchanged via colab/src/phase5_common.py, identical to the Phase 5C training procedure
frozen_encoder_recipe.trained_on: train_subjects only, known activities only for supervised episodes; no selection, integration, or test subject window is used in training
frozen_encoder_recipe.selection_rule: None. No model, checkpoint, epoch, or hyperparameter selection may use MotionSense labels beyond the training subjects. Final-epoch checkpoints are kept (same rule as Phase 5C deviation D3, applied here from the start rather than as a discovered deviation).

frozen_promotion_policy.calibration: Phase 3D quantile calibration computed from train and selection subjects only: novelty_false_alarm_quantile 0.02, local_distance_quantile 0.90, agreement_similarity_quantile 0.10
frozen_promotion_policy.query_accounting: Every oracle call is counted against the budget, including calls whose answer is a known activity. Candidates are not filtered by ground truth before querying.
frozen_promotion_policy.integration_clients: integration_subjects act as federated clients (4 per fold); their labels are hidden from discovery, matching, and promotion and are revealed only to the simulated oracle for at most 4 medoids per fold and to compute metrics.

preregistered_baselines.source: colab/src/phase5_common.py; identical implementation to Phase 5A/5C, all baselines share the encoder, calibration, clients, and 4-query budget
preregistered_baselines.random_query: Uniformly sample up to 4 retained local clusters across clients and query their medoids (20 seeds, mean reported).
preregistered_baselines.support_only: Rank all retained local clusters by support without cross-client agreement; query the top 4.
preregistered_baselines.novelty_top_b: Query the 4 single windows with the highest novelty score across clients; each queried window becomes a one-window prototype.
preregistered_baselines.centralized_oracle: Pool all integration windows, cluster centrally with the same distance threshold, rank by support, query the top 4 (upper bound; not federated).
preregistered_baselines.component_mixture: Fed-GCD-style: per-client Gaussian mixture components matched at the server by Hungarian assignment on cosine similarity; rank matched pairs by support; query top 4.

primary_hypothesis: H1: On MotionSense test subjects, ranked_mnn achieves higher mean novel macro-F1 than random_query, and does so in at least 5 of 6 folds.
secondary_hypotheses: H2: ranked_mnn achieves higher mean entry purity than support_only.
H3: ranked_mnn uses no more label queries than support_only.
H4: The gap between centralized_oracle and ranked_mnn novel macro-F1 is less than 0.15 (cost of federation).

gates.G1_cache_integrity: All 24 subjects x 6 activities present; at least 40 windows per subject-activity cell; channel count 4; window length 128.
gates.G2_known_geometry: Mean prototype known macro-F1 on test subjects >= 0.75.
gates.G3_primary: H1 holds (ranked_mnn novel macro-F1 > random_query mean AND in >= 5/6 folds).
gates.G6_budget: Label queries <= 4 in every fold (hard constraint; violation invalidates the run).

statistics: Means over 6 outer folds with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals (10000 resamples over folds); paired per-fold differences reported for every baseline against ranked_mnn. With 6 folds, exact paired sign tests are reported but the preregistered decision rule is the fold-count criterion in G3.
execution_order: 1. Commit this manifest to https://github.com/mhshayesteh/FedVocabHAR before downloading MotionSense.
2. Phase 6-A: download A_DeviceMotion_data.zip, build cache, apply input_scale 9.80665, run G1 only. No labels beyond the G1 count table are inspected.
3. Phase 6-B: train one encoder per fold on train_subjects; save checkpoints; no metrics on non-train subjects are printed.
4. Phase 6-C: run ranked_mnn and all baselines on integration clients; evaluate on test subjects; open test labels exactly once; write per-fold JSON, CSV, and decision JSON.
5. Any deviation must be recorded in phase6_deviations.md before results are reported.
rule: This is the second, and pending outcome likely final, confirmatory dataset for this manuscript cycle. If any gate fails, the result is reported as a failed confirmatory test alongside Phase 5C, exactly as PAMAP2 and UCI-HAR's G1 were reported; MotionSense may not be reused for redesign, tuning, or selection.
relationship_to_phase5c: This phase exists solely to test whether the Phase 5C confirmatory result (ranked_mnn beats random_query in 5/5 folds on UCI-HAR) generalizes to a second, structurally similar but sensor-different dataset (waist smartphone total acceleration vs. phone-carried userAcceleration), using an identical frozen encoder recipe, identical locked policy and quantiles, and an identical known/novel activity split logic (stairs as novel). No numbers from Phase 5A-5D were used to change any setting below.
